_about: Business rules of the X Education CRM in one place. The backend and the research scripts read this file; restart the backend after editing it. Step keys are fixed (the models know them); their labels, costs and discounts can be changed.

lifecycle_stages._about: The usual CRM lifecycle, worked out from what the learner did.
lifecycle_stages.Engaged: watched a video, read the brochure or testimonials, joined a webinar, or came back for a second visit
lifecycle_stages.MQL: marketing-qualified: looked at pricing, wishlisted a course or used the help assistant
lifecycle_stages.SQL: sales-qualified: sent an enquiry, added to the cart or started checkout
lifecycle_stages.Lost: closed by the team with a reason: no automatic steps until someone re-opens the lead

call_capacity._about: Capacity-aware next-best-action. daily_call_capacity is how many counsellor calls the team can make in a day (8: one counsellor, besides call-backs). 'priced': a call slot gets a price worked out from the last lookback_days of decisions, and a call is created only when it adds more than that price over the best step without a call (see backend/app/ml/capacity.py). 'fcfs': first come, first served until the daily capacity is used. Until min_decisions decisions with a possible call exist, the price is 0.

discount_budget._about: Discount money is the business's second scarce resource (counsellor time is the first). Without a budget a coupon is given whenever it adds more profit than it costs. The owner can set a monthly discount budget on the Planner page: every rupee of expected discount then gets a price, worked out from the last lookback_days of decisions and the budget left this month, and a coupon is sent only when the profit it adds is worth more than the discount it uses (see backend/app/ml/budget.py). With fewer than min_decisions decisions where a coupon paid, the price is 0 and coupons simply stop when the budget is used up.

planner._about: The owner's planner: what one more counsellor (counsellor_daily_calls more call slots a day) would add against counsellor_monthly_cost. The owner can change the cost on the Planner page.

automation_minutes._about: How long after the event a follow-up is considered, and how often the automation job runs.

cooldown_hours._about: Hours before the same automatic follow-up can reach a person again; manual_repeat: hours before the team can send a person the same email step again by hand. A person holds at most one open coupon whatever these say.

score_refresh_minutes._about: How often every lead is re-scored with the current model and the time since their last visit (also at start-up and right after the learning loop switches models).

learning._about: The automatic learning loop. A new model replaces the old one only if it predicts the untouched control group (global_control) better in at least swap_confidence of the bootstrap resamples.
learning._lead_age: Learn how much a lead's age (days since sign-up: 7-14, 14-30, 30+) changes its chance to buy, next to the time away, and keep it in the score. false switches it off.

ab_testing._auto_adopt: When a test is final and an email without a discount clearly won, it becomes the standard information email for that audience. adoption_check_share of the audience keeps the old email, so the CRM keeps checking that the winner still wins, and switches back by itself if it does not.

global_control._about: A fixed random share of leads that never gets automatic follow-ups (no next-best-action steps, campaigns or A/B emails). It measures the CRM's total impact and is the learning loop's honest check. Usual practice is 1 to 15%.

starting_history._about: On the first start the backend creates six months of history for 2,000 simulated learners (addresses @demo.xeducation.test, never emailed, tagged 'simulated' in the dashboard), so the CRM has data to learn from on day one. Remove it with: python -m app.cli history remove

live_simulation._about: While the backend runs, the simulated learners keep using the website in real time: they come back, react to the CRM's emails, coupons, calls and WhatsApp messages, and buy through the same API a browser uses; new ones sign up every day. Only the learners are simulated: their call and WhatsApp tasks wait in Today's actions for the team like everyone's, and when someone presses Call there, the simulated learner answers or not. enabled=false stops them (the Simulation page can also pause them).

team._about: Team accounts and lead owners. New leads (real or simulated) and any lead with an open task or call-back request are given to an active counsellor automatically (round_robin: in turn; least_loaded: whoever has the fewest open tasks and call-backs); older leads without open work stay unassigned until an admin gives them out. The Team page (admins) can change auto_assign, assignment_rule, the service-level hours and task_expiry_days; its choices are kept in the database and take precedence over this file. task_expiry_days: an open call or WhatsApp task nobody did by then closes itself as expired (0 = never).
